sermon.title: The Seventh Seal Part 1
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: In this message Pastor David G. Kincer opens the seventh seal at Revelation 8, arguing that the visions are not in sequence and that the prayers of the saints ascending to God show the church is still on earth. He reads Psalm 18, leads the church in prayer, and begins the first trumpets.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added by hand, and obvious caption errors were corrected; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: the captions give “Revelations 2111 or 211”; this is written as Revelation 21:1, which is the passage he reads. A phrase cut off in the captions (“there’s no s…”, near 6:00) is marked [unclear], and so is a word near 21:45 (“in … [unclear]”). The names “Buffet” and “Gates” (about 3:00), “Mr. Barnes” (about 8:10) and “Chuck Smith” (about 12:30) are as the captions show them. He says “Psalms 18 verse 6 and also in 2 Samuel” and reads on through the psalm.. He reads a prayer including “come with Your lightning bolts… come with Your earthquakes… with Your hail and fire… subdue our enemies under our feet,” and says “that’s how Korea prays, that’s how Africa prays.” The water percentages in the trumpet section (about 69% salt water, 1.7% fresh) are his figures as spoken and were not checked. He criticizes a claim about 144,000 Jews and describes others’ chart teaching; these are his opinions as spoken.

chunks.short_answer: He says “it wouldn’t need to ascend if they were in heaven,” and “It’s ascending because the prayers are going on where? On earth.” He adds, “there’s no word ‘rapture’ in the Bible.”

chunks.section_question: What do the first trumpets show? (Revelation 8:7-11)
chunks.short_answer: He reads the first trumpets, hail and fire, a burning mountain in the sea, and the star Wormwood, and says “There’s no time period given here at all.” He says “they fabricate these time periods.”
chunks.text:
life. Hallelujah. Praise God. Now we get the seventh trumpet. Now we get the seven trumpets. Number one, you can read this in Revelations 8:7: “The first angel sounded, and hail and fire mingled with blood was cast into the earth. One third of the trees and one third of the grass was burnt up.” There’s no time period given here at all. “A great fiery mountain” — the second trumpet — “was cast into the sea, and one third of the sea was turned to blood, and the sea creatures died, one third of them, and the ships were destroyed and sunk.” And it doesn’t say the people on them were destroyed. I don’t know why God didn’t tell us everything, and besides, I just believe He’s given us illustration of what’s going to take place before He comes. The burning wormwood star falls on earth. Here comes, now the stars are gone, supposedly, if you believe in the sequence, but here comes a star out of nowhere, fallen from something that’s not up there

anymore, and it’s called wormwood, and it’s bitter. And, you know, that 69% of the earth is salt water, correct? scriptures.text_nkjv: The first angel sounded: And hail and fire followed, mingled with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. And a third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.

Then the third angel sounded: And a great star fell from heaven, burning like a torch, and it fell on a third of the rivers and on the springs of water. The name of the star is Wormwood. A third of the waters became wormwood, and many men died from the water, because it was made bitter.

faqs.question: What does he say is under the seventh seal?
faqs.answer: He says there are “seven seals, seven trumpets, and seven bowls,” and “The seventh seal, which is the full opening of the book.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: When He opened the seventh seal, there was silence in heaven for about half an hour.

faqs.question: Why does he say the sixth seal cannot be in sequence?
faqs.answer: He says “the heavens rolled up like a scroll… where are the moon and sun? In the heavens, right? So they’re gone,” so “this cannot be in sequence.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then the sky receded as a scroll when it is rolled up, and every mountain and island was moved out of its place. And the kings of the earth, the great men, the rich men, the commanders, the mighty men, every slave and every free man, hid themselves in the caves and in the rocks of the mountains, and said to the mountains and rocks, “Fall on us and hide us from the face of Him who sits on the throne and from the wrath of the Lamb!

faqs.question: What does he say about the 144,000?
faqs.answer: He says “that is pure fantasy” of a claim he read, and “God is going to do a lot more than 144,000 people.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: And I heard the number of those who were sealed. One hundred and forty-four thousand of all the tribes of the children of Israel were sealed:

faqs.question: Why does he say two tribes are missing?
faqs.answer: He says “you think God’s mixed up up there? No, He’s not. He’s just trying to give an illustration of sealing the saints.”

faqs.question: Who gets the white robes of righteousness?
faqs.answer: He says “We’re all given these white robes of righteousness because of the blood Jesus shed, and we believe and trust it and accept it.”

faqs.question: What does he say about a thief in the night?
faqs.answer: He says “the Bible says a thief comes in an hour when what? You know not.” He asks, “honking his horn… I’m going to sleep through that?”

faqs.question: Where does he say God’s people are when Jesus comes?
faqs.answer: He says “Where are the people of God still when Jesus comes? On earth.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: But you, brethren, are not in darkness, so that this Day should overtake you as a thief.

faqs.question: What does the angel with the golden censer do?
faqs.answer: He says the angel “stands at the altar, the altar of gold, and he has a golden censer, and he offers much incense before the throne.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then another angel, having a golden censer, came and stood at the altar. He was given much incense, that he should offer it with the prayers of all the saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne. And the smoke of the incense, with the prayers of the saints, ascended before God from the angel’s hand.

faqs.question: What does he say “ascend” means?
faqs.answer: He says “Anybody know what the word ‘ascend’ means? Go up. So where are the saints? Below, on earth.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then the angel took the censer, filled it with fire from the altar, and threw it to the earth. And there were noises, thunderings, lightnings, and an earthquake.

faqs.question: Does he say the word “rapture” is in the Bible?
faqs.answer: He says “There’s no rapture yet, and there’s no word ‘rapture’ in the Bible. They’re talking about 1 Thessalonians, where it says ‘we’re caught up.’”

faqs.question: Does he say we should pray out loud?
faqs.answer: He says “We would never know the prayers of David and those prophets of old if they just thought them. They prayed them out loud.”

faqs.question: What does he mean by “the sacrifice of praise”?
faqs.answer: He says “You say, ‘Well, I’m not in it today.’ Then do the sacrifice. Grow up.”

faqs.question: Does he say the trumpets give time periods?
faqs.answer: He says “There’s no time period given here at all,” and “There’s no time period given.”

scriptures.text_nkjv: The first angel sounded: And hail and fire followed, mingled with blood, and they were thrown to the earth. And a third of the trees were burned up, and all green grass was burned up.
